εἰσοράω: to look into, look upon, view, behold
μεθίημι: to let go, let loose, release
παρίημι: to pass over, let go, relax, yield, allow
πείθω: to prevail upon, win over, persuade
προσκαλέω: to call to, call on, summon
προστίθημι: to add, to apply, to close (a door); mid. to join (a group), take as an ally
προτίθημι: to place before, to propose, to prefer
πωλέομαι: to go up and down, go to and fro
συγκαλέω: to call to council, convoke, convene
ἀνίημι: to send up; let go, abate
ἀνακαλέω: call on, invoke; call back, recall
ἀντεπιτίθημι: entrust in answer; mid. counter attack
ἀποπροίημι: to send away forward, send on
ἐγκαλέω: to call in; bring a charge or accusation
ἐπιτίθημι: to lay, put on; (mid.) to attack
ἐφίημι: to send to; (mid) to long for
ἵημι: to set a going, put in motion
